+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+@dataclass
+class MetricSeriesComparison:
+    left: List[Dict[str, Any]]
+    right: List[Dict[str, Any]]
+    metric: str
+    start: str
+    end: str
+    left_filter: Dict[str, Any]
+    right_filter: Dict[str, Any]
+
+
+def _parse_time(value: Optional[str], default: datetime) -> datetime:
+    if not value:
+        return default
+    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
+        parsed = parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    return parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc)
+
+
+def _normalize_filters(filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return filters or {}
+
+
+def compare_metric_series(
+    metric: str,
+    left_filter: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
+    right_filter: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
+    start: Optional[str] = None,
+    end: Optional[str] = None,
+    granularity: str = "PT1H",
+) -> MetricSeriesComparison:
+    api_key = os.environ["DATADOG_API_KEY"]
+    app_key = os.environ["DATADOG_APP_KEY"]
+    base_url = os.getenv("DATADOG_API_BASE_URL", "https://api.datadoghq.com")
+
+    end_dt = _parse_time(end, datetime.now(timezone.utc))
+    start_dt = _parse_time(start, end_dt - timedelta(hours=1))
+
+    payload = {
+        "data": {
+            "type": "timeseries_request",
+            "attributes": {
+                "from": start_dt.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
+                "to": end_dt.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
+                "queries": [
+                    {
+                        "data_source": "metrics",
+                        "query": metric,
+                        "aggregator": "avg",
+                        "interval": granularity,
+                        "group_by": [],
+                        "filter": _normalize_filters(left_filter),
+                    },
+                    {
+                        "data_source": "metrics",
+                        "query": metric,
+                        "aggregator": "avg",
+                        "interval": granularity,
+                        "group_by": [],
+                        "filter": _normalize_filters(right_filter),
+                    },
+                ],
+            },
+        }
+    }
+
+    headers = {
+        "DD-API-KEY": api_key,
+        "DD-APPLICATION-KEY": app_key,
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        f"{base_url}/api/v2/query/timeseries",
+        json=payload,
+        headers=headers,
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    series = data.get("data", {}).get("attributes", {}).get("series", [])
+    left = series[0] if len(series) > 0 else {}
+    right = series[1] if len(series) > 1 else {}
+
+    return MetricSeriesComparison(
+        left=[left] if left else [],
+        right=[right] if right else [],
+        metric=metric,
+        start=payload["data"]["attributes"]["from"],
+        end=payload["data"]["attributes"]["to"],
+        left_filter=_normalize_filters(left_filter),
+        right_filter=_normalize_filters(right_filter),
+    )
+
+
+__all__ = ["MetricSeriesComparison", "compare_metric_series"]
*** End Patch

+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+GOOGLE_CLOUD_MONITORING_ENDPOINT = "https://monitoring.googleapis.com/v3"
+
+
+def _access_token() -> str:
+    token = os.getenv("GOOGLE_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN") or os.getenv("GCP_ACCESS_TOKEN")
+    if not token:
+        raise ValueError("Missing Google Cloud access token")
+    return token
+
+
+def _project_name(project_id: Optional[str]) -> str:
+    resolved = project_id or os.getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT") or os.getenv("GCP_PROJECT")
+    if not resolved:
+        raise ValueError("Missing Google Cloud project id")
+    return f"projects/{resolved}"
+
+
+def _parse_time(value: Optional[str]) -> datetime:
+    if not value:
+        return datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+    text = value.replace("Z", "+00:00")
+    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
+    if dt.tzinfo is None:
+        dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc)
+
+
+def filter_metric_dimensions(
+    metric_type: str,
+    *,
+    project_id: Optional[str] = None,
+    start_time: Optional[str] = None,
+    end_time: Optional[str] = None,
+    resource_type: Optional[str] = None,
+    resource_labels: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
+    metric_labels: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
+    page_size: int = 100,
+) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    project = _project_name(project_id)
+    end_dt = _parse_time(end_time)
+    start_dt = _parse_time(start_time) if start_time else end_dt - timedelta(hours=1)
+
+    filter_parts = [f'metric.type = "{metric_type}"']
+    if resource_type:
+        filter_parts.append(f'resource.type = "{resource_type}"')
+    if resource_labels:
+        for key, value in resource_labels.items():
+            filter_parts.append(f'resource.labels."{key}" = "{value}"')
+    if metric_labels:
+        for key, value in metric_labels.items():
+            filter_parts.append(f'metric.labels."{key}" = "{value}"')
+
+    params = {
+        "filter": " AND ".join(filter_parts),
+        "interval.startTime": start_dt.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
+        "interval.endTime": end_dt.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
+        "pageSize": page_size,
+    }
+
+    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {_access_token()}"}
+    url = f"{GOOGLE_CLOUD_MONITORING_ENDPOINT}/{project}/timeSeries"
+    results: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    while True:
+        response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params, timeout=30)
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        payload = response.json()
+        results.extend(payload.get("timeSeries", []))
+        token = payload.get("nextPageToken")
+        if not token:
+            break
+        params["pageToken"] = token
+
+    return results
+
*** End Patch
